name: Sunset Horizon Mural
description: A breathtaking panoramic wall mural capturing the ethereal beauty of a sunset over rolling hills. Hand-painted with rich warm tones of amber, burnt sienna, and deep violet. Perfect for living rooms and reception areas.

name: Abstract Bloom Series
description: A vibrant collection of abstract floral compositions exploring the intersection of color theory and organic form. Each piece uses bold impasto techniques with palette knife work creating rich texture.

name: Tranquil Garden Suite
description: A serene bedroom painting series featuring delicate watercolor-style botanicals and soft pastel gradients. Designed to create a calming atmosphere for personal spaces.

name: Heritage Facade Art
description: A large-scale exterior mural celebrating Indian architectural heritage through contemporary artistic interpretation. Weather-resistant paints ensure lasting vibrancy against the elements.

name: Golden Peacock Panel
description: An opulent custom commission featuring a majestic peacock rendered in gold leaf and deep jewel tones. This statement piece combines traditional Indian motifs with modern artistic flair.

name: Lobby Grand Landscape
description: A sweeping landscape installation designed for a five-star hotel lobby. Multiple connected canvas panels create an immersive forest panorama that welcomes guests with natural serenity.

name: Minimalist Line Art
description: A sophisticated series of minimalist continuous-line drawings depicting human forms and botanical elements. Elegant in its simplicity, this piece adds contemporary refinement to modern interiors.

name: Children's Fantasy World
description: A whimsical children's room mural featuring a magical forest filled with friendly animals, floating castles, and rainbow skies. Hand-painted with child-safe, non-toxic paints.
